name: Trend Following - EM Equity Universe + 15% Vol Target
description: Applies systematic trend following (EWMA momentum, risk-parity weighted) to the emerging-market equity universe (India, China A-shares, EM IMI ESG screened, UBS Core MSCI EM), capturing EM regional/style trends independently of developed markets, then scales to 15% annualised volatility. Tests trend mechanics across a structurally distinct volatility and correlation regime.
